about: Default email formats an organisation starts with (D-032). The model or the agent writes only the body; opening and signature are static blocks merged verbatim, with {{placeholders}} filled from the call.

formats.name: Follow-up
formats.subject: Following up on our call
formats.body: Thank you for your time today. As promised, here is a short summary and the next step we agreed on.

formats.name: Meeting confirmation
formats.subject: Confirming our meeting
formats.body: This confirms our next meeting. Reply to this email if the time no longer works for you.
